html:
G'oya

Ikki bosqichli savol. Avval har oy va mahsulot uchun jami miqdor kerak, bu oddiy GROUP BY month, product. Keyin har oy ichida shu jamilarni o'rinlarga qo'yib, 1-o'rindagilarni olamiz. Teng bo'lganlarning hammasi chiqishi kerak, shuning uchun RANK.

Yechim

SELECT month, product, total_qty
FROM (
  SELECT month, product, SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY SUM(qty) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY month, product
) t
WHERE rnk = 1

Window funksiya GROUP BY dan keyin hisoblanadi, shuning uchun OVER ichida SUM(qty) ni ishlatsa bo'ladi: u guruhning yig'indisi. RANK o'rniga DENSE_RANK ham to'g'ri bo'lardi, 1-o'rinda ular farq qilmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Guruhlashni o'tkazib yuborib, eng katta bitta savdoni olish. Namunada yanvarning eng katta savdosi Choy (30 dona), lekin Qahva ikki marta sotilgan: 25 + 10 = 35. Oy g'olibi Qahva:

Noto'g'riSELECT month, product, qty AS total_qty
FROM (
  SELECT month, product, qty,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY qty DESC) AS rnk
  FROM sales
) t
WHERE rnk = 1

ROW_NUMBER teng miqdorli mahsulotlardan faqat bittasini qoldiradi. PARTITION BY month yozilmasa, o'rinlar butun yil bo'yicha qo'yiladi va faqat eng kuchli oyning g'olibi qoladi.

Boshqa yo'l

O'rin o'rniga oyning eng katta jamisini MAX ... OVER bilan har qatorga yozib, unga tenglarini olish ham mumkin:

WITH t AS (
  SELECT month, product, SUM(qty) AS total_qty
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY month, product
)
SELECT month, product, total_qty
FROM (
  SELECT t.*, MAX(total_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY month) AS mx
  FROM t
) x
WHERE total_qty = mx
